Atlanta Capital Management Co LLC Continues to Hold Position in Aramark (ARMK)
May 4, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Investors sentiment increased to 1.01 in 2017 Q4. Its up 0.17, from 0.84 in 2017Q3. It increased, as 32 investors sold ARMK shares while 95 reduced holdings. 46 funds opened positions while 82 raised stakes. 223.63 million shares or 2.13% less from 228.50 million shares in 2017Q3 were reported. Dekabank Deutsche Girozentrale owns 0.04% invested in Aramark (NYSE:ARMK) for 134,910 shares. Quantbot Limited Partnership holds 0% or 704 shares in its portfolio. Westpac Banking reported 14,268 shares stake. Bnp Paribas Asset Mngmt holds 0.12% or 333,855 shares in its portfolio. Goldman Sachs Group Inc stated it has 0.01% in Aramark (NYSE:ARMK). Stratos Wealth Ptnrs Ltd reported 0% stake. Thematic Prns Lc has 2.85% invested in Aramark (NYSE:ARMK) for 2.02 million shares. Meeder Asset holds 0.04% or 10,251 shares in its portfolio. Thomas White Interest has invested 0.08% of its portfolio in Aramark (NYSE:ARMK). Guardian Capital Lp has 8,990 shares. Moreover, Lazard Asset Mngmt Limited Liability Co has 0% invested in Aramark (NYSE:ARMK) for 31,900 shares. Steinberg Asset Mgmt Lc holds 2.12% or 117,805 shares. Sterling Ltd, a North Carolina-based fund reported 15,763 shares. Quebec – Canada-based Pub Sector Pension Inv Board has invested 0% in Aramark (NYSE:ARMK). Lionstone Mngmt Lc, a New York-based fund reported 496,300 shares.
Atlanta Capital Management Co Llc increased its stake in Aramark (ARMK) by 2.39% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Atlanta Capital Management Co Llc bought 238,109 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.48% with the market. The institutional investor held 10.22 million shares of the restaurants company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $436.77M, up from 9.98 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Atlanta Capital Management Co Llc who had been investing in Aramark for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $9.00B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.97% or $0.36 during the last trading session, reaching $36.61. About 1.52M shares traded or 12.54% up from the average. Aramark (NYSE:ARMK) has risen 8.52% since May 4, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.03% the S&P500.
Atlanta Capital Management Co Llc, which manages about $16.77B and $19.04B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Fortive Corp by 52,214 shares to 1.49M shares, valued at $107.68M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 118,696 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 80,920 shares, and cut its stake in 3M Co (NYSE:MMM).
More news for Aramark (NYSE:ARMK) were recently published by: Businesswire.com , which released: “Aramark Named a Top 50 Company for Diversity by DiversityInc” on May 02, 2018. Bizjournals.com ‘s article titled: “Mount Ida food service provider Aramark to cut all 77 employees on campus” and published on April 24, 2018 is yet another important article. Among 7 analysts covering ARAMARK Holdings ( NYSE:ARMK ), 5 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 2 Hold. Therefore 71% are positive. ARAMARK Holdings has $51.0 highest and $42 lowest target. $47.71’s average target is 30.32% above currents $36.61 stock price. ARAMARK Holdings had 10 analyst reports since November 14, 2017 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Buy” rating by Nomura given on Wednesday, November 15. RBC Capital Markets maintained Aramark (NYSE:ARMK) rating on Tuesday, November 14. RBC Capital Markets has “Buy” rating and $46.0 target. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Tuesday, December 19 by RBC Capital Markets. The stock of Aramark (NYSE:ARMK) earned “Buy” rating by RBC Capital Markets on Thursday, January 18. The stock of Aramark (NYSE:ARMK) earned “Buy” rating by RBC Capital Markets on Tuesday, February 6. The stock of Aramark (NYSE:ARMK) earned “Hold” rating by Barclays Capital on Friday, December 22. Stifel Nicolaus initiated Aramark (NYSE:ARMK) rating on Tuesday, December 19. Stifel Nicolaus has “Buy” rating and $50.0 target. On Wednesday, January 31 the stock rating was maintained by Morgan Stanley with “Equal-Weight”. The rating was maintained by Credit Suisse with “Outperform” on Wednesday, January 24.
